basic_info.description: This sun-drenched 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom corner home is a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience, offering 1,913 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space across two levels. Nestled on a 2,250 sq. ft. lot, this inviting residence boasts gorgeous wood floors with intricate trims, exuding warmth and character from the moment you step inside.  The main level is an entertainer's dream, featuring a spacious living room with a striking cove ceiling, a bright picture window, and a cozy fireplace, creating a perfect setting for relaxation. Flowing seamlessly into the elegant formal dining room, this space is ideal for hosting intimate gatherings or festive celebrations. The stylish kitchen is a culinary delight, equipped with stainless steel appliances, a charming bistro nook, and a skylight that bathes the space in natural light.   The lower level unveils two fully legal rental units, presenting a fantastic opportunity for rental income or multi-generational living. The first unit features two spacious bedrooms and one bathroom, while the second offers a cozy one-bedroom, one-bath layout, each designed for comfort and functionality.  Helen Chen 415-385-9552
